name: Normhyra.ai
description:
Normhyra.ai is a free calculation engine for Swedish "normhyra" (normalized rent) – the standard method for comparing apartment rents in Swedish rent negotiations and rent tribunal proceedings.
Key features:
• Convert actual rents to normalized values per the three established norm tables (Norm -78, -91 and -12), and back
• Process entire rent rolls in one request – Swedish apartment type designations like "2 rok", "3RK" or "1 RKvr" are parsed automatically, and monthly rents are converted to yearly
• Generate shareable PDF reports with per-apartment tables and summary statistics (download links valid 7 days, files auto-deleted)
• Works directly in Claude for Excel – convert the rent roll you have open without exporting anything
No account or authentication required. Calculation inputs are never stored. Results include the attribution "Powered by Normhyra.ai – en produkt av Hyran.ai". Primarily useful in Swedish.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Normhyra.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Normhyra.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.normhyra.ai/.

_published_faq.name: Is Normhyra.ai MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Normhyra.ai scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Normhyra.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Normhyra.ai provides these MCP tools: calculate_actual_rent, calculate_normhyra, calculate_rent_roll, export_rent_roll_pdf, and list_apartment_types.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Normhyra.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Normhyra.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Normhyra.ai does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Normhyra.ai is developed by Nordic Rent Intelligence Group AB. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
